tiny_state: Maya is a station engineer standing in the break room.

action_category.instructions: What kind of action should this character take right now? Choose "nothing" only if continuing the current action is clearly the best option.

criteria.use_item: Use an item being held or carried
criteria.inventory: Rearrange, pick up, drop or store items
criteria.think: Stop to think carefully about plans

move_target.instructions: Suppose this character decides to walk somewhere now. Which destination would they choose? Pick "none_of_these" if no listed destination fits their goals.

criteria.chief_engineer: Walk over to Chief Engineer Ruiz at the engineering console
criteria.grey_jumpsuit: Follow the person in the grey jumpsuit
criteria.fire_alarm: Walk to the fire alarm panel
criteria.kitchen_door: Walk to the door to the kitchen
criteria.atmospherics_door: Walk to the open door to atmospherics
criteria.east_corridor: Walk back to the east maintenance corridor

move_direction.instructions: Suppose this character walks in a direction instead of to a named destination. Which direction best serves their goals, given what they perceive?

criteria.north: Toward the engineering console and the fire alarm
criteria.east: Toward atmospherics and the east corridor
criteria.southeast: Toward the cargo side of the station
criteria.south: Toward the table and the medical bay
criteria.west: Toward the vending machine and security
criteria.northwest: Toward the engineering locker and the dorm

move_extent.instructions: Suppose this character walks in a direction. How far should they go before reconsidering?

criteria.one_step: A single step, to look around or reposition
criteria.medium: About the length of a room
criteria.until_obstacle: Keep going until blocked or arriving somewhere

goal_blocked.instructions: Does the character's first immediate goal appear impossible or blocked with the actions and information currently available to them?

interact_target.instructions: Suppose this character interacts with something within reach. Which interaction would they perform?

criteria.pick_up_sandwich: Pick up the sandwich from the table
criteria.pet_cat: Pet the sleeping cat under the table

use_item.instructions: Suppose this character uses an item they are holding or carrying. Which use would they choose?

criteria.radio_engineering: Call the engineering channel on the radio
criteria.radio_common: Call the common channel on the radio
criteria.oxygen_tank: Put on the emergency oxygen tank

inventory_action.instructions: Suppose this character rearranges their items. Which item action would they take?

criteria.stow_welder: Put the welding tool in the backpack to free the right hand
criteria.hold_wrench: Take the wrench out of the tool belt
criteria.hold_multitool: Take the multitool out of the tool belt
criteria.drop_metal: Drop the two metal sheets from the backpack

speak_target.instructions: Suppose this character says something now. To whom would they speak?

criteria.chief_engineer: Chief Engineer Ruiz, at the console to the north
criteria.grey_jumpsuit: The unknown person in the grey jumpsuit

speak_intent.instructions: Suppose this character says something now. What would be the main purpose of what they say?

criteria.ask: Ask for something or ask a question
criteria.reply: Reply to what was just said to them

think_mode.instructions: Suppose this character stops to think carefully. How deeply would they think?

criteria.light: Think briefly about what to do next (cheap)
criteria.deep: Reconsider plans thoroughly using everything they know (expensive)

sleep_where.instructions: Suppose this character goes to sleep now. Where would they sleep?

criteria.dorm_bed: A bed in the engineering dorm
criteria.break_room_couch: The couch in the break room

emotion.instructions: Which emotion is this character most likely feeling right now, given everything above?

criteria.trust: Feeling safe with, accepting or relying on others
criteria.surprise: Caught off guard by something unexpected
criteria.anticipation: Eager or tense expectation of something coming
